newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arab League says Hebron deal to boost confidence.
newsitem.headline: Arab League says Hebron deal to boost confidence.

text.p: The Arab League on Thursday welcomed a deal on Palestinian self-rule in the West Bank town of Hebron but said Israel must follow through with progress on other tracks of the peace process.

"The Hebron deal is a first step on the way to bolstering the desired and necessary confidence and it must be completed with rapid steps on the other negotiation tracks in a way that will achieve a complete Israeli withdrawal from all occupied Arab land," said an Arab League statement.
The 22-member Arab League is based in Cairo.
Talks between Israel and its Arab neighbours Syria and Lebanon have been stalled for months.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat sealed the accord on Wednesday and agreed on a timeframe for further Israeli pullbacks in the West Bank.
Under the accord, Israeli troops will hand over 80 percent of the city and the agreement provides for joint patrols by Israeli and Palestinian forces.
